52275.author: mroguljic
52275.body:
#### PR description:

Cluster shape filter (ClusterShapeHitFilter) reads its pixel cut windows from text files shipped with CMSSW so changing them requires a new release. This PR adds a conditions payload for these pixel windows, so they can be changed via GTs.

Payload consists of any number of tables, each with one row per cluster size (part dx dy + 8 window limits, i.e. the .par columns without the unused density/points statistics), plus an ordered list of rules assigning BPIX layers / FPix disks to a table. This allows more flexibility than current implementation that only differentiates L1 / rest of BPIX / FPIX.

No change in output is expected: the record is not consumed yet. After this is in a release, the payloads will be uploaded and added to the GTs, and a follow-up PR will switch ClusterShapeHitFilterESProducer and ClusterShapeHitFilter from the files to the record.

####  If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:
